relation: pressure build-up and valve opening establish a developing underexpanded-jet state
boundary_conditions: Use time-resolved upstream pressure, opening state, ambient pressure, and nozzle geometry.
main_limitation: Direct HPDI-resolved gas-state measurements remain incomplete.
notes: Retained as M01 mainline link.

relation: nozzle, ambient, gas, and pressure-definition boundaries condition underexpanded-jet formation
boundary_conditions: Fixed NPR and fixed injection pressure are not interchangeable; real-gas and species effects remain coupled.
main_limitation: No common factorial condition set spans the boundary variables.
notes: M01 supporting link.

relation: underexpanded state establishes Mach-disk formation and dimensions
boundary_conditions: NPR numerator role, absolute/gauge basis, nozzle geometry, gas, and transient state must match.
main_limitation: Diameter and transient appearance thresholds are less constrained than position.
notes: M02 closed within compatible gas-jet conditions.

relation: underexpanded expansion and recompression organize shock cells and transient wave topology
boundary_conditions: Gas species, exit turbulence, nozzle shape, and near/far-field location must be retained.
main_limitation: Quantitative topology is model- and condition-sensitive.
notes: M02 closed at topology level, not as a universal correlation.

relation: injector transient drives Mach-disk motion, overshoot, and stabilization
boundary_conditions: Formation, instantaneous, overshoot, and quasi-steady observables require event alignment.
main_limitation: A scalar nominal NPR cannot encode the transient.
notes: Direct time-history support.

relation: Mach-disk motion changes the downstream local gas pressure, density, and velocity state
boundary_conditions: The observation location and shock-decay or notional-nozzle assumptions must be validated.
main_limitation: No direct co-located HPDI pilot-droplet forcing measurement.
notes: M03 becomes indirect before application transfer.

relation: shock-cell, expansion-wave, and vortex topology redistributes local gas state
boundary_conditions: Wave origin, near/far field, ambient sound speed, density, and interaction stage must match.
main_limitation: Gas-state-to-pilot-droplet mapping is absent.
notes: Includes injector-generated and reflected-shock analogues without equating them.

relation: local gas-state jumps determine instantaneous aerodynamic and pressure loading magnitude
boundary_conditions: Keep incident-shock, post-shock freestream, local relative, and reacting post-wave states distinct.
main_limitation: The local state is not measured for HPDI pilot droplets.
notes: Direct in canonical loading; application edge remains open.

relation: finite shock and expansion topology limits the effective loading duration
boundary_conditions: Shock-front passage, shocked-state exposure, expansion-limited interval, and total forcing are separate.
main_limitation: B-library wave history is not converted to a pilot-droplet exposure history.
notes: Qualitative B-to-C bridge only.

relation: loading magnitude and material/size references define the droplet nondimensional response state
boundary_conditions: Every We, Re, Oh, and Mach comparison requires definition-complete references.
main_limitation: Many records remain incomplete-reported despite verified source extraction.
notes: No universal We-only state is asserted.

relation: loading-duration to response-time compatibility augments instantaneous nondimensional loading
boundary_conditions: Use typed loading interval and an explicitly defined droplet response time.
main_limitation: No literature-established universal duration ratio is available.
notes: A candidate metric is recorded separately as a project hypothesis.

relation: definition-complete loading state governs deformation timing and morphology
boundary_conditions: Mach context, d0, liquid properties, arrangement, and observation interval must match.
main_limitation: Dense polydisperse reacting sprays are not validated.
notes: M04 strongly closed in canonical conditions.

relation: internal wave focusing and circulation imprint later deformation
boundary_conditions: Wave-speed ratio, phase state, geometry, and omitted physics constrain transfer.
main_limitation: Evidence includes two-dimensional and model-resolved cases.
notes: Mechanism is retained separately from external aerodynamic loading.

relation: neighboring droplets and clouds redistribute effective loading through shielding, squeeze flow, closure, and attenuation
condition_domain: ordered multidroplet and dilute cloud shock interaction
boundary_conditions: Arrangement, S/D, volume fraction, droplet size, and We must be specified.
main_limitation: Ordered/dilute conditions do not equal dense HPDI spray.
notes: Direct collective-effect evidence.

relation: deformation creates sheets, rims, shear layers, and waves that select competing instabilities
boundary_conditions: Forcing history and instability-label definitions vary.
main_limitation: Broad taxonomy retains the missing C004 limitation.
notes: Intermediate mechanism between deformation and fragment production.

relation: instability competition produces condition-dependent secondary breakup modes
boundary_conditions: We, Mach, d0, liquid properties, and loading duration jointly set accessible modes.
main_limitation: Universal critical-We boundaries are not supported.
notes: M05 strongly closed with definition boundaries.

relation: secondary breakup generates evolving fragment-size, velocity, spacing, and mass distributions
boundary_conditions: Sampling time and fragment-detection definitions must be compatible.
main_limitation: Fragment product statistics are sparse.
notes: M06 direct but incompletely quantified.

relation: fragment population state governs subsequent cloud transport and dispersion
boundary_conditions: Wave origin, population density, fragment velocity, and ambient state differ across studies.
main_limitation: No common dataset resolves full fragment distributions and transport.
notes: M06 transfer from canonical fragments to spray transport is conditional.

relation: droplet clouds attenuate and reshape transmitted shock pressure history
boundary_conditions: Exchange area, volume fraction, droplet size, shock strength, and breakup closure must match.
main_limitation: Dense reacting-spray attenuation is not validated.
notes: Feedback from population to loading.

relation: breakup and evaporation may occur on overlapping time scales for sufficiently small droplets or strong waves
boundary_conditions: Droplet size, liquid, thermal state, detection threshold, and post-wave gas history must match.
main_limitation: Most broader phase-change evidence is model-heavy or RDE-specific.
notes: M07 coupling is supported but not universal.

relation: phase change can suppress or promote deformation by competing vapor-layer shear reduction and thermal property changes
boundary_conditions: Stefan number, volatility, density ratio, gas temperature, d0, and observation interval control direction.
main_limitation: The transition boundary is not constrained by matched-condition studies.
notes: Direction is explicitly non-universal.

relation: smaller fragments increase exchange area and shorten characteristic evaporation or survival scales
boundary_conditions: Fragment-size definition, gas history, liquid properties, and evaporation model must match.
main_limitation: Direct fragment-resolved HPDI evaporation evidence is absent.
notes: Conceptual bridge without a universal closed-form relation.

relation: transport and dispersion reorganize mixture distribution
boundary_conditions: Geometry, wall interaction, ambient state, and penetration/entrainment metrics are condition-specific.
main_limitation: Shock-generated fragment contribution is not isolated.
notes: Direct for general transport-to-mixture behavior.

relation: evaporation contributes vapor to mixture formation
boundary_conditions: Size, thermal state, volatility, phase-change model, and chamber mixing history must match.
main_limitation: Actual HPDI mixture-field contribution from shock-driven breakup/evaporation is not measured.
notes: M08 becomes cross-domain before the requested shock-mediated application chain.

relation: injection chronology, overlap, and geometry determine premixing and stratification
boundary_conditions: Dwell, sequence, overlap, ambient reactivity, injector arrangement, and operating point must match.
main_limitation: Local species and flow fields are not uniformly measured.
notes: Strong A-library pathway independent of shock-droplet attribution.

relation: mixture and pilot-product distribution govern ignition timing and location
boundary_conditions: Fuel pair, oxygen level, temperature, overlap geometry, and event definitions bound the relation.
main_limitation: Mechanism attribution sometimes relies on model fields or author interpretation.
notes: M09 directly supported for mixture/chronology effects.

relation: ignition chronology and propagation set heat-release mode and combustion response
boundary_conditions: Load, timing, energy share, injection duration, and diagnostic definitions must match.
main_limitation: Emissions and stability tradeoffs are operating-point dependent.
notes: Direct application pathway.

relation: shock-mediated breakup and evaporation alter the actual HPDI mixture field
boundary_conditions: Requires condition-matched shock, droplet/fragment, evaporation, and mixture diagnostics.
main_limitation: The causal chain is not directly isolated.
notes: Retained explicitly as an evidence-gap pathway.

relation: a shock-induced mixture change causes a measurable HPDI ignition or combustion change
boundary_conditions: Requires synchronized shock, mixture, ignition, and heat-release measurements.
main_limitation: Separate-domain evidence cannot establish this causal arrow.
notes: Central downstream evidence gap.

relation: droplet size and evaporation scales feed back on detonation/RDE wave stability and structure
boundary_conditions: Fuel, chemistry, geometry, pre-vaporized fraction, wave number, and characteristic scales must match.
main_limitation: Mostly numerical/application-scale evidence.
notes: M10 direct within RDE domain only.

relation: detonation leading wave and reacting post-wave history load and deform droplets
boundary_conditions: Leading-shock Mach does not fix post-wave velocity, sound speed, pressure gradient, or duration.
main_limitation: Shock-derived coefficients may fail under reacting histories.
notes: Strong-wave analogue, not HPDI evidence.

relation: canonical single- or ordered-droplet response transfers directly to dense polydisperse HPDI pilot spray behavior
boundary_conditions: Requires realistic size distribution, spacing, volume fraction, turbulence, thermal state, and chemistry.
main_limitation: Shielding, attenuation, wakes, and phase change can change the mechanism.
notes: M11 remains indirect-only.

relation: underexpanded-jet Mach-disk and shock-cell topology maps to the local loading history of actual HPDI pilot droplets
boundary_conditions: Requires co-located time-resolved shock, gas-state, and pilot-droplet measurements.
main_limitation: No direct spatial-temporal HPDI measurement closes the edge.
notes: M03/M11 central unclosed bridge.

relation: RDE or detonation droplet-scale coupling transfers to HPDI mixture and ignition behavior
boundary_conditions: A validated mapping of loading, chemistry, residence, and characteristic-scale ratios is required.
main_limitation: RDE/detonation evidence cannot substitute for HPDI measurements.
notes: Bounded strong-wave analogy only.
